<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_script_include"><sys_script_include action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><access>public</access><active>true</active><api_name>x_946454_food_de_0.getMenuDetails</api_name><caller_access/><client_callable>true</client_callable><description/><mobile_callable>false</mobile_callable><name>getMenuDetails</name><sandbox_callable>false</sandbox_callable><script><![CDATA[var GetMenuItemsByRestaurant = Class.create();
GetMenuItemsByRestaurant.prototype = Object.extendsObject(global.AbstractAjaxProcessor, {
    
      getMenuItemsForRestaurant: function(restaurantId) {
        //var restaurantId = this.getParameter('sysparm_restaurant_id');
        var menuIds = [];

        if (!restaurantId) return '';

        var gr = new GlideRecord('x_946454_food_de_0_menu_items'); // Replace with your actual table name
        gr.addQuery('restaurant_name', restaurantId); // Assuming this is a reference field
        gr.query();

        while (gr.next()) {
            menuIds.push(gr.getUniqueValue());
        }

        return 'sys_idIN' + menuIds.join(',');
	}
});
